{{Quote|Treaded neutron torches. They have fireball-shooting cannons that blast through rock.|Obi-Wan Kenobi, to Andra|<ref name="tdor" />}}
'''Treaded Neutron Torches (TNTs)''' were [[Tank/Legends|tank]]-like vehicles that fired [[Neutron/Legends|neutron]] blasts from cannons positioned on their "nose". They were originally designed as [[Mining/Legends|mining]] machinery, blasting into [[rock]] to open up new shafts. During his [[Trioculus affair|brief time]] as [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]], the [[mutant]] named [[Trioculus]] used several TNTs as frontline mobile [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]].

==Characteristics==
TNTs were boxlike in shape. They had four treaded [[wheel]]s on each side, which were protected with armored plating. On the front face was a narrow horizontal windshield and two top-mounted cannons.<ref name="lcotj" /> A TNT's interior was spacious enough to accommodate at least one person and a canister containing a protective outfit and helmet that were designed as heat shields.<ref name="potds">[[Prophets of the Dark Side (novel)|''Prophets of the Dark Side'']]</ref> Thanks to its twin fireball-shooting [[neutron cannon]]s, it could easily blast into solid [[rock]].<ref name="tdor" />

==History==
{{Quote|I didn't know there'd be a fire, and TNTs, and stormtroopers, and&mdash;Wow, you're Han Solo, right?|Ken, to Han Solo|<ref name="lcotj" />}}
The TNTs were created for use in the [[Spice mines of Kessel/Legends|Spice Mines]] of [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]<ref name="AGTSWU2">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> when the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was still the dominant [[Politics/Legends|political regime]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. By [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], some could also be found on [[Telos IV]], where [[malab]] was being mined. Their primary function was to blast through rock in order to open up new mine shafts.<ref name="tdor" /> Following the fall of the Republic, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] took over the mines of Kessel. The Imperial [[Supreme Slavelord]] of the Spices Mines, a three-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]] [[mutant]] named [[Trioculus]], discovered other uses for the TNTs. During his [[Trioculus affair|stint]] as [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], he employed them to [[Plan Number Two|burn down]] the forests of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] in his search for the [[Lost City of the Jedi]]. One of them managed to bring down the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].<ref name="lcotj" />

{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Treaded Neutron Torches first appeared in ''[[The Lost City of the Jedi]]'',<ref name="lcotj" /> the second novel in [[Paul Davids|Paul]] and [[Hollace Davids]]'s so-called [[Adventures of a Jedi Prince|''Jedi Prince'' series]]&mdash;which was released from [[1992]] to [[1993]].<ref name="TERC" /> They made a second appearance in [[Prophets of the Dark Side (novel)|''Prophets of the Dark Side'']], the serie's sixth and final book.<ref name="potds" /> In [[2000]], author [[Jude Watson]] reused them in ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Day of Reckoning]]'',<ref name="tdor" /> which is set 49 years before the ''Jedi Prince'' saga.<ref name="TERC" />
